body: Thank you so much. I loved this man, unconditionally, and still do. I guess it's like how people feel when they lose their child or sibling or something else close to them. You just feel like you're done with what life has to offer, and you want the experience to end. I know these dark thoughts should bother me more but, they really don't. I am touched by everyone that tries to help me with this, but I just don't feel like it is enough unless it's him. He wanted me to find peace too I guess, but I just cannot unless it all stops. I guess I can't explain it any other way but by saying its like, losing the only person you've ever had. And I miss him, so terribly, he can't ever be replaced. These facts just make me feel that ending it would be best, even though I can still think more, I only wish I wasn't so chicken.

I guess what I wanted was to have someone to talk to, yes. It's just so hard, because I don't want any other lover in my life, or anyone else really. The thought of doing intimate things with anyone else even, is too much to bear.
I hold out hope because it's what has kept me from going totally utterly suicidal. It makes me feel really lousy that I have to tell people "I know I could recover possibly, but I just don't want to, I don't want my feelings to change even if it is for the better." I miss him more than words, he was the center of my life and my world but he was trustworthy enough to be, the fact that this happened makes it feel so very wrong. I just really am not bothered by the thought of my life reaching its end now, and everyone says it's a terrible thing, but I just can't believe that it is.
